settings.intro_highlight: The Multi-Comfort treatment chair bridges the gap between practitioner posture and long-term client support. This unit reduces operational strain during repetitive facial and body protocols without sacrificing stability.
settings.custom_description: The Multi-Comfort treatment chair is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including Estheticians, Medical Spa Therapists, and Cosmetic Injectors. Its fully adjustable backrest, leg rest, and headrest target postural strain and lower-back tension during high-volume clinic days, enabling sharp focus on treatment execution and service consistency. Whether you are performing deep-pore cleansing, microdermabrasion, or precise hair removal procedures, this treatment chair adjusts to your workflow need with a smooth 15° tilt mechanism and a hydraulic height system for model 20200.
settings.subtitle: Ergonomic Excellence for High-Performance Salons
settings.secondary_description: Ultra-resistant leatherette upholstery is central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the material integrity and hygienic finish of the Multi-Comfort chair, clean routinely with surface disinfectants formulated for professional spa environments after every client session. The non-porous exterior offers superior stain and oil resistance, ensuring a pristine clinical condition across years of daily use. Consistent care prevents premature surface wear and preserves cushion firmness.

settings.question: Licensed esthetician:
settings.answer: For the licensed esthetician executing intricate facial extractions or microdermabrasion, maintaining proper neck and lumbar alignment is critical during extended care sessions. The Multi-Comfort chair features a 15° seat tilt and an adjustable headrest that allow the practitioner to bring the client’s facial plane closer without hunching. This posture-centric adjustment reduces shoulder fatigue and wrist strain, allowing for steady hands and seamless movements across back-to-back treatment slots.

settings.question: Cosmetic injectors :
settings.answer: For cosmetic injectors and Clinical spa therapists performing delicate procedures, sub-millimeter stability is non-negotiable. Model 20200 provides adjustable height from 27 inches to 34 inches. Practitioners can elevate or lower the client to the working height needed for symmetrical sightlines, minimizing visual fatigue and improving treatment consistency.

settings.question: Hair removal specialists and Body treatment technicians:
settings.answer: For hair removal specialists and body treatment technicians, client transition speed and position security govern overall daily efficiency. Manual adjustment of the backrest and leg rest allows transformations from an upright consultation angle to a reclined treatment position. Supported by ultra-durable, easy-to-sanitize upholstery, the workstation maintains stability and hygiene across demanding clinic schedules.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Position the client centrally on the chair while keeping the backrest in a neutral upright position.
Adjust the vertical height between 27 inches and 34 inches to match your posture, following the supplied hydraulic-height instructions for model 20200.
Adjust the backrest and leg rest sections manually to the desired angle.
Engage the 15° tilt system when enhanced access to the neck and facial contours is required.
Secure all adjustment mechanisms before commencing clinical treatments.
Do not exceed the maximum operational weight capacity during height or tilt adjustments; confirm the rated value with Equipro.
Ensure all adjustment points are fully engaged before applying downward pressure on the headrest or leg extension.
Wipe down all leatherette surfaces using non-abrasive, alcohol-free disinfectants to prevent material drying and cracking over time.

settings.question: What is the difference between model 20200 and model 20210?
settings.answer: Model 20200 uses a manual hydraulic system, whereas Model 20210 features a motorized electric height adjustment.

settings.question: What width options are available for the Multi-Comfort chair?
settings.answer: The unit is available in both 24-inch and 28-inch cushion width configurations.

settings.question: Are armrests included with the base chair?
settings.answer: Armrests are optional removable accessories designed to fit the chair frame.

settings.question: What is the height adjustment range of the unit?
settings.answer: The Canada catalog description lists a working height from 27 inches up to 34 inches.

settings.question: Is the upholstery resistant to oils and clinical products?
settings.answer: The chair features ultra-resistant leatherette designed specifically for professional salon and spa environments.
